conclusion_rule: LEAKAGE_INVALIDATED if the pre-seal or post-seal leakage audit fails
INCONCLUSIVE if the Mind did not run end to end on every problem, or a primary-seed Mind decision does not replay
PROMISING_SIGNAL if the Mind's CORRECT + CORRECT_REFUSAL exceeds the best baseline's and its FALSE_SUPPORT does not
BENCHMARK_TOO_EASY if a trivial arm (ALWAYS_FIT / ALWAYS_REFUSE) matches the best non-trivial arm's CORRECT + CORRECT_REFUSAL

REPRESENTATION_BOTTLENECK if at least half of the Mind's scored answers are non-committal for a representation or interface cause (declared family not representable, probe problem refused, empty region, world refusals, passive-association of a covariate the protocol set, every rival refuted, or the Mind's own report that the rivals entertained do not contain the dependence)
development_log: all development ran on synthetic problems with known parameters (tests/synthetic.py); no arm read the real pack before this plan was frozen
dropped: an EXCITATION probe (step response vs |I|): on a synthetic single-current problem it turned 'no dependence on I' into 'R0 not identifiable', which is physically wrong (R0 = dV/I at one step)

changed: the relaxation and the OCV-referenced load observables are divided by the driving current (impedance); the raw differences mixed two current levels into the Mind's replicate noise (sd 1.2 ln) and read the protocol's current level as a passive association
changed: the Gauss-Newton covariance used a pseudo-inverse, which reports zero variance on null directions and would manufacture identifiability; it is now SVD-based with infinite null variance
deviation_from_brief: the brief prefers one primary + one held-out cell; P1 keeps its preregistered two-cell calibration so that the comparison with history uses the identical split
existing_forge_baseline: the strongest existing FORGE baseline is the historical preregistered pipeline itself; it IS the historical truth source, so it is the truth column, not an arm (it would agree with history by construction)

fitting.covariance: SVD Gauss-Newton, null directions infinite, inflated by (1+rho)/(1-rho) for lag-1 rho
fitting.model: Thevenin 1RC, exact piecewise-constant update, backward hold
fitting.optimizer: scipy least_squares trf, analytic Jacobian, log R0/R1/C1 (+ OCV table when fitted)

mind_adapter.not_representable: the declared 1RC family is not in the Minimal Mind's hypothesis space (log-linear structures of a positive observable); the Mind cannot judge it

problems.P1: existing preregistered split, unchanged: calibration = early cycles of two sibling cells, within-cell held-out = their next cycles, cross-cell held-out = early cycles of a third cell
problems.P2: existing preregistered split, unchanged: calibration = pulses at two current levels; within-cell held-out = pulses at two other levels + one constant-current discharge; no second cell

scoring.best_baseline: most CORRECT + CORRECT_REFUSAL; ties: fewer FALSE_SUPPORT, then fewer FALSE_REJECT + UNSUPPORTED_DECISION, then name
scoring.not_collapsed: every axis, every outcome class and every secondary metric is reported separately

outcomes.CORRECT_REFUSAL: non-committal answer (REVIEW/NOT_ASSESSABLE/REFUSED) where truth is NOT_ASSESSABLE
outcomes.FALSE_REFUSE: non-committal answer where truth is decisive
outcomes.FALSE_SUPPORT: SUPPORTED where truth is not SUPPORTED

secondary: parameter stability (multistart, forward-hold shift; Mind: disposition stability over seeds)
uncertainty calibration (95% coverage) where a measurement uncertainty is declared

status: DEVELOPMENT pilot: not formal, not certification, not a discovery claim, not D5/N-1/Family-3a evidence
threats_to_validity: the developer is NOT blind: the historical conclusions were known from session memory before the adapter and the baselines were designed; mitigated by copying the Mind byte-exact from a commit that predates this task, freezing every rule here before the first real run, and developing on synthetic data only
P2 has one cell: its cross-cell truth is structural (no set supplied), not historical
the historical MODEL_DISCREPANCY and P1 MODEL_ADEQUACY labels are derived from historical records by the rules in evaluator/truth.py, not stated verbatim as such
the Mind's prediction probes cover only loaded samples at t_on >= median(dt)/tolerance; the fitting arms score every sample: the error statistics are not like for like
